plants.annotation: plant graph labels; segmentation used for QC only
plants.edge_policy: binary undirected adjacency; exact repeated segment records collapsed, distinct paths retained

octasynth.annotation: supplied projected synthetic vascular graph, retain adjacency; not independently hand-traced skeleton

plan.query_policy: shared capacity >=96, derived from maximum contracted training GT across available source/target datasets; transfers all query slots unchanged
plan.design: one B0 mixed plant+target training-split checkpoint per vessel dataset; common checkpoint initializes B0/Axyz; target finetuning vessel-only
plan.stopping: fixed epochs; stop on nonfinite/error; no automatic extension, sweep or threshold change
plan.protocol_revision: user correction: plants mixed with target vessels, not pure plants
plan.pretraining_geometry: pixel for both domains; original dataset caches and target fine-tuning/evaluation calibration unchanged
